name: draz-flutter
description: Agent Skills for production Flutter work: design fidelity, architecture, state management, accessibility, and a pre-commit review gate.

plugins.name: flutter-design-fidelity
plugins.description: Keeps Flutter implementation matching the design. Enforces design tokens over hardcoded values, translates Figma Auto Layout into Row and Column rather than Stack, runs a screenshot diff loop instead of accepting the first render, and freezes the result in golden tests.

plugins.name: flutter-code-quality
plugins.description: Flutter architecture and quality conventions. Feature-first layering with a pure Dart domain, Cubit and Bloc emission and rebuild rules, responsive layout, accessibility and RTL requirements that design files never specify, performance rules, and a read-only pre-commit review gate.
